General.Description:
The Thornwood has not had a queen in a thousand years. The forest remembers. It has been waiting with the patient, implacable certainty of something that has outlived every empire that ever claimed to own it.

Briars Ashvale has spent her entire life avoiding the Thornwood. Growing up on the forest's edge, she knows the rules: do not enter after dark, do not follow lights between the trees, and above all do not speak to anything that asks you your name. She breaks all three rules in a single night, and wakes in the heartwood with thorns growing from her skin and a voice in her blood that calls itself queen.

Thornwood Chronicles: The Rise of the Thorn Queen is the first book in Evander Briggs's planned trilogy, and it announces a major new fantasy voice. Briggs writes the natural world with a reverence that never tips into sentimentality, and his court of ancient forest entities is genuinely strange — not merely humans with pointed ears, but beings whose logic and loyalties are as alien as they are compelling.

Briars Ashvale is a protagonist worth following into the dark. This is lush, fierce, intelligent fantasy at its best.
